gwt.given: a Customer model with a mapped @CustomerId property and a writable [MapToModel] Address property whose Address type maps @Street and @City, and a Customer instance whose Address is null
gwt.when: input parameters are created from that Customer, and later a Customer is read from a data reader row containing CustomerId, Street and City columns
gwt.then: the input parameter set contains @CustomerId, @Street and @City in one flat collection, and the original Customer's Address has been assigned a new, empty Address instance; the model read from the reader has a non-null Address whose Street and City come from the same row as CustomerId
